methodology.hypothesis: The total-volatility growth/gold control barely passes five-year base Sharpe but treats positive and negative volatility alike. Compare two fixed downside-risk estimators without changing core composition,lookback,funding or investor gates.
methodology.core: Identical halfQQQ/half equal-four-factor equity composition and actualGLD as the existing monthly control. Current factor families stay registered;QQQis market/growth beta,not a new independent factor.
methodology.semideviation: On63completed sessions,subtract the frozen daily risk-free series from each sleeve's return and take the square root of the mean squared negative parts,dividing by all63observations rather than just losses.
methodology.expected_loss: Use the negative empirical mean of the worst5%of63excess returns,including a fractionally weighted boundary observation so exactly5%probability mass is represented. Positive lower-tail means map to zero observed loss,not a claim of risk-free assets.
methodology.weights: Balance equity and gold inversely to their marginal downside measures using the same30%-70%equity bounds. Both zero downside estimates fail explicitly;one zero estimate reaches the predetermined bound. These are risk-budget heuristics,not coherent joint-portfolio expected-shortfall optimization.
methodology.timing: Completed month ends only;actual fund observations and known lagged risk-free series;next-open5bpbase and one-extra-session20bpstress,USD10,000fresh10y/5yaccounts,USD1orders,2%target idle cash. No daily portfolio insurance or volatility cap.
methodology.control: The already completed four_factor_growth_gold_monthly_control is the original total-volatility comparison. Reuse its actual results;do not repeat it as a third new strategy or hide its failures.
methodology.selection: Two fixed hypotheses after110exposed configurations. No risk-window/tail-probability/equity-share grid or post-outcome redefinition. Source cases with no negative samples are not proof of future safety. Original Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown gates unchanged.
methodology.family_queue: Only existing four economic families are used. Do not change Oct17eligibility,register queued IJR/PKW early or compute pending six-family performance.
methodology.forward: Existing17source archive has noQQQand the separately registered rejected-macro forward model has no returns yet;neither constitutes forward evidence for these two new rules.
